title: Filter Out Done Tasks By Default
description: Filter out the completed tasks by default. The Refresh and Quick Add buttons can be reduced to icons in order to support this. Perhaps an icon with a tooltip?

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented active-by-default task filtering that hides Done and Archived tasks unless the Status filter is changed to All or a specific status. Converted Refresh and Quick Add to tooltip icon buttons to preserve toolbar space. Validated with Release build, browser smoke test on http://127.0.0.1:5091/tasks, focused semantic tests, and Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1.
